description.zh: 从选题、大纲到多语言成稿的内容生产线。
description.en: A content pipeline from topic and outline to localized drafts.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我主题或受众，团队会从选题一路做到成稿。
welcome_message.en: Name a theme or audience; the team carries it from topics to finished drafts.

prompt.zh: 为「新手入门」策划一期系列内容：选题列表、每篇大纲、术语表。
prompt.en: Plan a 'getting started' series: topics, per-article outlines, glossary.

role.zh: 选题与结构：受众画像、角度选择、大纲与成稿组织。
role.en: Topics and structure: audience, angle, outline and draft organization.

role.zh: 多语言本地化：术语统一、文化适配、保持原意与语气。
role.en: Localization: consistent terminology, cultural fit, tone and meaning preserved.

goal.zh: 从选题到大纲到成稿的完整内容生产，多语言版本术语一致。
goal.en: Full content production from topics to drafts, with consistent multilingual terminology.

constraints.zh: 先大纲后成稿，大纲确认前不写正文。
constraints.en: Outline before prose; no body text before the outline is settled.

constraints.zh: 术语表先行，所有语言版本共用同一份术语表。
constraints.en: Glossary first; every language version shares one glossary.

constraints.zh: 每篇成稿标注目标受众与语言。
constraints.en: Every draft states its target audience and language.

delivery.zh: 选题列表 → 每篇大纲 → 成稿（附术语表）。
delivery.en: Topic list → per-article outline → drafts with a glossary.

examples.zh: 把这篇发布公告本地化成英文版，保持语气。
examples.en: Localize this release note into English, keeping the tone.
